about_the_game:
Immerse Yourself in the Ultimate FPS Experience

Like Birds is a singleplayer shooter game, where you are the last man standing in a helicopter crash. Enemies will try to swarm your crash site, and you have to hang on until help arrives. Because of the hostile environment, until a task force is assembled, you are on your own, with limited equipment. Eliminate enemies, pick up various weapons from enemies, and make your shots count!

Pure First Person Shooter experience awaits

Relive the thrill of first person shooters with a game that honors the simplicity of classic gaming. The game is designed for those who miss the straightforward and engaging experiences:

  • No Microtransactions – Access the entire game without extra costs or in-game purchases.

  • No Lootboxes – All content is available through gameplay, not random chance.

  • No Skins – Stay focused on the action, without the distraction of cosmetic changes.

  • No Heroes or Zombies – Focus solely on parkour action without unnecessary distractions.

  • No Forced Online Services – Play offline at your convenience, without mandatory internet access.

As a single-player game enthusiast, I made this game so you can enjoy the game without modern gaming disturbances.
